description.value: Ohyama Ramen is a noodle restaurant tucked above the Royal Bank in Whistler's village core, serving ramen with vegan menu options. Both dine-in and takeout are available, with online ordering also offered. It sits in a convenient location for cyclists moving through the Whistler Valley corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website clearly confirms the address (204-4000 Whistler Way, above the Royal Bank) and provides a phone number (604) 962-6253 absent from OSM. Takeout is explicitly stated on the front page; OSM's diet:vegan=yes is the only evidence for vegan options since the menu subpage links out rather than listing items inline. No mention of bike infrastructure, washrooms, water refill, or any other cycle-specific amenities appears on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone (604) 962-6253 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null as there is no OSM value to cross-check.
